point: # The controls spec of press-hydraulic for the panel shop (lib/panel-shop.md): written by the core 2026-11-09 from design.md. One row per point the panel (pnl-press-hydraulic) must serve. The panel is an enc-wm wall-mount on the frame's rear post. Ratings cite the elements' ratings.csv or are marked.

rating: 30 A feeder (Assumption (B): the shop's branch circuit is not on file)
control transformer, 150 VA class (Assumption (B): PSU 60 W, safety relay 4 W, HMI and solenoids on 24 V DC through the PSU)
note: secondary X2 grounded; the PSU fed from it through a 2-pole control-circuit breaker (the lesson of pm-motor-starter)

rating: 7.5 kW, 460 V, 3 ph, 60 Hz (hpu-7.5kw ratings.csv); FLA NOT ON FILE (generic design: NEC Table 430.250 gives 11 A for 7.5 kW / 10 hp at 460 V, the sizing figure per 430.6(A)(1))
note: one motor branch: disconnect, branch breaker, contactor, overload sized to the nameplate FLA when on file; direct on line
the PLC runs the pump; the e-stop chain drops K1 too (stop category 0); the ram's safety function is on the valve solenoids
95-96 stays hardwired in the contactor's coil chain; the controller reads the trip on 97-98 (as mc-motor-1, request panel-1 3.d, 2026-11-11)

rating: valve solenoid a (ram down), 24 V DC; coil power NOT ON FILE (hyd-valve-d03 not yet built)
note: through the safety relay's output 13-14: no down command without both hands and a clear curtain

rating: valve solenoid b (ram up), 24 V DC
note: through the safety relay's output 23-24 (the return stroke stops too; ISO 13849-1 category 3, Assumption (A): for EM)

rating: pressure switch (set 140 bar: Assumption (B), 160 bar relief)
note: pressure at the valve's P port is up

rating: pt 0-250 bar (two-wire, loop powered from the panel's 24 V)
note: the HMI's pressure reading and the PLC's over-pressure alarm

standard: IEC 61131-2 type 3; NFPA 79 9.2.5.2 (NC for a stop function)

signal: two-hand control, type IIIC (both within 0.5 s, both released to re-arm)
note: the two-hand station's four contacts (NO + NC per button) into the safety relay's two-hand input (relay-safety-2ch-2no1nc's CI mode is single-function: a two-hand input needs the 440R two-hand variant or a second relay: panel shop's call, a request to elec if a new element)

signal: light curtain OSSD1 / OSSD2, PNP 24 V DC
note: into the safety relay's dual-channel input; the curtain's own supply from the panel's 24 V

rating: stop category 0 on the ram (valve centres) and the pump (K1 drops), PL d / category 3 (Assumption (A): for EM)
note: two e-stops in one chain into the safety relay
the PLC knows why the ram stopped (HMI message)

standard: IEC 61076-2-101 (D coding) if M12; RJ45 inside the panel
note: the HMI on the panel door: pressure, cycle count, the stop reason

rating: pilot light red: fault / safety stop
frame and HPU skid bonding to the panel's PE
